title: Support needs of persons who experience a loss by assisted suicide
summary:
Background: Relatives of individuals who die by assisted suicide (AS) face various challenges, however, despite their oftentimes crucial involvement in the processes of the AS, their experiences and support needs remain poorly understood. As a result, specific support services are often not available. 

Aim of the study: This study aims to explore the experiences and support needs of relatives bereaved by AS in Germany from various perspectives, and to provide recommendations for the development of effective support systems for this group. 

Methods: We will recruit relatives who have experienced a loss by AS (subproject 1), (healthcare) professionals, and representatives of supporting organizations (subproject 2) to participate in qualitative semi-structured interviews. After transcription, the qualitative data will be analysed using qualitative content analysis in line with Kuckartz. The results will be used as the basis for expert workshops following a Group Delphi Technique with the aim to develop recommendations that ensure that relatives of persons who die by AS receive sufficient support before, during and after their loss (subproject 3).
conditions: Experiences and support needs of people who have lost a loved one through assisted suicide.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
TP1: Age ≥ 18 years; sufficient knowledge of German; written informed consent; identification as a relative of a person who (a) died by suicide within the last 15 years and (b) was residing in Germany at the time of death.
TP2: Age ≥ 18 years; sufficient knowledge of German; written informed consent. Group a: (healthcare) professional in one of the following fields: general practice, palliative medicine, psychiatry/psychotherapy, geriatrics/gerontology, nursing, occupational therapy, physiotherapy, social work, self-help, ethics, or church; professional/work-related experience with individuals who wish to seek assisted suicide and/or their relatives. Group b: individuals professionally involved in the work of an organization that provides assisted suicide, e.g., physicians, managers, lawyers, board members, or other staff (voluntary or employed).
TP3: Age ≥ 18 years; sufficient knowledge of German; written informed consent; individuals who meet the inclusion/exclusion criteria of subprojects 1 and 2, as well as individuals with expertise in the fields of suicide prevention, ethics, and bereavement.
Exclusion criteria:
TP1: Current high levels of emotional stress.
